title: The ledger is deleted in one change; the journal reads nothing but itself and the example files
situation: The retire-ledger story deletes the ledger. Its capability, its harness-facing capture of agent runs and its files reach every package, and the concept journal's views read it for the work in flight, for which stories are done and so whose example files are history, and for which cuts were integrated and so which decisions about them are deprecated. The plan read-back is the lead's to take under the operator's delegated authority.
decision: (1) One task, one builder, one pull request carrying the story's design and its realization together from the story's branch to dev: the deletion is coupled across the packages and passes the check only whole. One reviewer; the operator reviews before it joins, a gate the lead holds. The plan read-back is taken by the lead: one deletion with no fork of value in it. (2) The ledger capability, its command and tool, the harness-facing command that captured agent runs and the extension's sending of them go; the extension still checks each dispatch's assignment and still names the acting agent for the journal. An installation upgraded from one that offered the ledger offers it no longer. (3) The journal's views read only the journal and the example files: an overview tells no work in flight; an example file present is current, and goes by being deleted, so a decision no longer keeps example files standing, though entries that recorded one still read; a decision recorded about a cut is read by its own status alone. (4) The ledger's files are deleted, nothing migrated. (5) Released change logs, recorded journal entries and the earlier-installation record stay as they are; pending change notes are rewritten so the next release states the ledger's removal and presents none. (6) Words that name some other record (a probe gate's readouts) are not the ledger and stay.
consequences: The overview's and leakage's explanations and the decide verb's parameters change with the views; no current example or decision of this project changes standing, since none is kept by a decision or recorded about a cut.
